name: @composable-os/pack-memberships
description: Memberships: membership plans sold as subscriptions (unlimited, or N classes a week or month), memberships that follow their subscription, pass types sold once (class packs that expire, drop-ins, a one-per-person intro offer) and the passes they grant, each an allowance a booking spends (stage 32b). Requires Bookings (its class types and services, and what a holder pays for). Installed in every deployment of a product that lists it. Bundled as source into cos-runner.

composableOs.label: Memberships
composableOs.description: Membership plans paid every month and class passes bought once, with what each allows and what is left. Requires Bookings.
